logger.doc:name: Log Flow Start
logger.message: #['[UC04] Flow triggered at ' ++ (now() as String)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java var today = now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'00:00:00'Z'"} --- "SalesOrderHeadersV4?\$filter=SalesOrderProcessingStatus eq Microsoft.Dynamics.DataEntities.SalesOrderProcessingStatus'Delivered' and SalesOrderOriginCode eq 'SHOPIFY' and RequestedShippingDate ge " ++ today

logger.doc:name: Log SO Header Query
logger.message: #['[UC04] D365 Query built | query=' ++ (payload default '')]

logger.doc:name: Log Delivered Headers Response
logger.message: #['[UC04] D365 returned delivered headers | payload=' ++ write(payload default [], 'application/json')]

logger.doc:name: Log Headers Count
logger.message: #['[UC04] Delivered orders to process | count=' ++ sizeOf(payload default [])]

logger.doc:name: Log Foreach Entry
logger.message: #['[UC04] Processing order | SalesOrderNumber=' ++ (payload.SalesOrderNumber default 'NULL') ++ ' | ShopifyOrderId=' ++ (payload.CustomersOrderReference default 'NULL')]

logger.doc:name: Log Box Query Built
logger.message: #['[UC04] Box query built | salesOrder=' ++ vars.salesOrderNumber ++ ' | shopifyOrderId=' ++ vars.shopifyOrderId ++ ' | query=' ++ (payload default '')]

logger.doc:name: Log Tracking Boxes Response
logger.message: #['[UC04] Tracking boxes returned | salesOrder=' ++ vars.salesOrderNumber ++ ' | payload=' ++ write(payload default [], 'application/json')]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- // Extracts the first available tracking number from the array of boxes (payload filter (!isEmpty($.TrackingNumber)))[0].TrackingNumber default ""

logger.doc:name: Log Tracking Number
logger.message: #['[UC04] Tracking extracted | salesOrder=' ++ vars.salesOrderNumber ++ ' | trackingNumber=' ++ (vars.trackingNumber default 'EMPTY')]

logger.doc:name: Log Before Shopify GET
logger.message: #['[UC04] Calling Shopify GET fulfillment_orders | shopifyOrderId=' ++ vars.shopifyOrderId ++ ' | tokenPresent=' ++ (!isEmpty(vars.shopifyToken default ''))]

logger.doc:name: Log Shopify GET Response
logger.message: #['[UC04] Shopify GET response | shopifyOrderId=' ++ vars.shopifyOrderId ++ ' | payload=' ++ write(payload default {}, 'application/json')]

logger.doc:name: Log API Error
logger.message: #['Shopify GET failed for Order ' ++ vars.shopifyOrderId]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var openFulfillments = (payload.fulfillment_orders default []) filter ($.status == "open" or $.status == "in_progress") --- openFulfillments[0].id default ""

logger.doc:name: Log Fulfillment ID
logger.message: #['[UC04] Open fulfillment extracted | shopifyOrderId=' ++ vars.shopifyOrderId ++ ' | fulfillmentOrderId=' ++ (vars.fulfillmentOrderId default 'EMPTY')]

logger.doc:name: Log POST Payload Built
logger.message: #['[UC04] POST payload built | shopifyOrderId=' ++ vars.shopifyOrderId ++ ' | payload=' ++ write(payload default {}, 'application/json')]

logger.doc:name: Log Before Shopify POST
logger.message: #['[UC04] Calling Shopify POST fulfillments | shopifyOrderId=' ++ vars.shopifyOrderId ++ ' | trackingNumber=' ++ vars.trackingNumber ++ ' | tokenPresent=' ++ (!isEmpty(vars.shopifyToken default ''))]

logger.doc:name: Log Shopify POST Response
logger.message: #['[UC04] Shopify POST response | shopifyOrderId=' ++ vars.shopifyOrderId ++ ' | payload=' ++ write(payload default {}, 'application/json')]

logger.doc:name: Log API Error
logger.message: Shopify POST failed.

logger.doc:name: Log Success
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- 'Successfully fulfilled order $(vars.shopifyOrderId) with tracking $(vars.trackingNumber)']

logger.doc:name: Log Already Fulfilled
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- 'Order $(vars.shopifyOrderId) is already fulfilled in Shopify. Skipping.']

logger.doc:name: Log Missing Data
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- 'Skipping D365 Order $(vars.salesOrderNumber). Missing Shopify ID or Tracking Number.']

logger.doc:name: Log Token Subflow Entry
logger.message: OAuth Dance for Shopify access token

logger.doc:name: Trace Retrieve Token
logger.message: #['TRACE shopify token retrieve completed | hasToken=' ++ (!isEmpty(vars.shopifyToken default ''))]

logger.doc:name: Log Fetching New Token
logger.message: Shopify Token expired or missing. Fetching new token from Shopify OAuth...

logger.doc:name: DEBUG Token Properties
logger.message: #['DEBUG shopify token props | host=' ++ (p('shopify.oauth.host') default 'NULL') ++ ' | clientId=' ++ (p('shopify.client.id') default 'NULL') ++ ' | clientIdLen=' ++ sizeOf((p('shopify.client.id') default '')) ++ ' | secretLen=' ++ sizeOf((p('shopify.client.secret') default ''))]

logger.doc:name: DEBUG Token Response
logger.message: #['DEBUG shopify token response | payload=' ++ write(payload default {}, 'application/json')]

logger.doc:name: Trace Set shopifyToken
logger.message: 'TRACE shopifyToken variable set'

logger.doc:name: Trace Store Token
logger.message: 'TRACE shopify token stored in object store'

logger.doc:name: Log Cached Token Used
logger.message: Using cached Shopify OAuth Token.
